name: manual_5f256c
claim: Re-read the clock after any network call before spending a time-bound single-use token; scope CLI credentials to an isolated store, delete them after use, and never treat deletion as revocation.

decisions.notes: Marker age was checked before a network call and spent after it; a config-dir variable does not isolate the OS credential store.

rationale: Marker age was checked before a network call and spent after it; a config-dir variable does not isolate the OS credential store.
